propositions: The session-scoped provenance fixture rebuilds parent maps and rescans cached AST trees millions of times instead of indexing once, causing 46.95–49.02s setup overhead per Ubuntu CI cell.
The _enclosing and _verdict helpers repeatedly call ast.walk on every source tree in src/rebar/ for each caller/parent lookup, performing 9.54M node iterations and 130.9M calls for unchanged output.
Immutable per-process parent/enclosing-function and call-site indices must be built once from already-cached parsed trees, then queried by _verdict and related helpers.
All 24 existing provenance tuples and verdicts must remain unchanged; exact tuple SHA-256 hash must be preserved through the optimization.

A deterministic oracle test must validate that each module contributes to indexing at most ~3 times (function discovery, site discovery, shared index) and fail RED if whole-tree rediscovery is reintroduced.
